title: A cornered dog will leap over a wall
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to thoroughly execute the Second Elder, a blood-red crack suddenly split the sky, and a giant eye composed of countless stars slowly opened from the crack—the power of the Heavenly Eye descending directly.

text.content: The Second Elder's killing intent solidified like a physical force. His withered hand suddenly rose, and a jet-black spiritual light erupted from his palm, heading straight for Chen Ji's Brow Center. This was his signature technique, the 'Soul Extinguishing Finger', specifically targeting cultivator souls. Once struck, it meant complete soul destruction. 'You worthless wretch! You know too much!' The Second Elder grinned wickedly, the spiritual light carrying bone-piercing killing intent, about to destroy Chen Ji completely.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stood in the distance, the corner of his mouth slightly raised, yet his eyes held not a trace of surprise. The fingers in his sleeve tapped lightly against his palm, as if waiting for a predestined ending. 'Enough,' he murmured in his heart, 'atrash is still atrash. Dying at my chess piece's hands is quite dignified after all.'

text.content: Yet just as the Soul Extinguishing Finger was about to touch Chen Ji's Brow Center, Chen Ji's eyes suddenly became deep and profound as an abyss, golden patterns wildly circulating in his pupils. A vast ocean-like aura explosively burst from within him. 'Did you truly think,' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, 'that calling you Elder, I was afraid of you?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, five fingers spreading open. That Soul Extinguishing Finger was firmly gripped in his palm, the jet-black spiritual light struggling wildly in his fingertips but unable to break free. 'Second Elder, did you think I didn't know how many hidden pieces you placed in the Tianqing Sect? Did you think I didn't know you've been secretly colluding with the Demonic Path Holy Sect for thirty years?' Chen Ji's voice remained calm, each word like a heavy hammer. 'Did you think I didn't know... that you are a dog of the Heavenly Eye?'

text.content: The Second Elder's face changed instantly, genuine fear appearing on that withered face for the first time. 'You... how could you possibly...' His voice trembled. Those secrets he thought were perfectly hidden had been exposed by thistrash disciple in a single sentence. The surrounding disciples burst into uproar, their gazes toward the Second Elder filled with more terror and doubt.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had completely dominated the situation, facing the terrified Second Elder, he chose:

choices.description: Activate the combined technique of the fourth level of the Tianji Record and the Break Bureau Eye, completely crushing him with absolute strength, letting him understand true disparity
choices.visible_reward: Completely intimidate everyone present, the Second Elder's soul severely wounded, unable to recover for three years
choices.risk_hint: Significant consumption, but can solve the problem in one go

text.content: At Chen Ji's Brow Center, the symbols of the Tianji Record suddenly glowed, golden light spreading from his body, transforming into mysterious formation patterns intertwining in the air. In his eyes, the power of the Break Bureau Eye and Tianji Record perfectly merged, an aura sufficient to crush everything erupting from him. 'What... what is this!' The Second Elder was terrified, feeling he faced not a person, but an ancient divine being.

choices.description: First use words to completely nail him to the pillar of shame, making him lose all reputation in front of everyone, then take action to deal with him
choices.visible_reward: The Second Elder's reputation completely destroyed, becoming a criminal of the Tianqing Sect for generations
choices.risk_hint: The Second Elder might desperately counterattack in desperation

text.content: Chen Ji didn't rush to act, instead standing with hands behind his back, a mocking arc playing at the corner of his mouth. 'Second Elder, thirty years ago in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, you secretly met the Demonic Path Holy Sect's envoy. What did you exchange? Would you like me to say it for you?' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present. The crowd was in an uproar, the Second Elder's face already as white as paper.

choices.description: Directly interrogate him about his relationship with the Heavenly Eye, uncovering deeper secrets
choices.visible_cost: Expose more information to those present
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Heavenly Eye, providing crucial information for subsequent scheming
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the Heavenly Eye's vigilance

text.content: "What mark did the Heavenly Eye leave in your body? Why do you go to the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds every month at midnight to kowtow?" Chen Ji pressed forward step by step, and with each word, the Second Elder's face grew paler. "Speak! How manyth piece of the Heavenly Eye's chess piece are you in the mortal realm!" Chen Ji's thunderous roar exploded, and the Second Elder's legs turned soft as he actually knelt on the ground.

Golden formation patterns swirled and intertwined around Chen Ji. The power of the fourth layer of the Tianji Record pressed down on the Second Elder like a solidified mountain. The once invincible Soul-Destroying Finger was completely shattered in Chen Ji's palm, dissolving into wisps of black dust that scattered. "Impossible! Impossible!" The Second Elder howled madly, his spiritual energy surging wildly, yet like an ant trying to shake a tree, he couldn't break free from that terrifying pressure.

dialogue.content: "Impossible?" Chen Ji slowly stepped forward, each step like trampling on the Second Elder's heart. "Thirty years ago, you made a deal with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, exchanging the blood essence of Tianqing Sect disciples for breakthrough in cultivation; twenty years ago, you secretly harmed over a dozen genius disciples during the Sect Competition; ten years ago, you leaked our sect's cultivation techniques to rival sects... Did you think I didn't know about these?" Chen Ji's eyes blazed with killing intent. "Not only do I know, I also know you have the 'Heavenly Fate Chain' planted by the Heavenly Eye in your body. Every Heavenly Fate person you kill, you can exchange one year of lifespan from it."

text.content: The Second Elder's body trembled violently. Those secrets he thought would never be uncovered were recounted by Chen Ji as if reading from a family account book. The gazes of the surrounding disciples had shifted from shock to disgust and fury—this dignified-looking elder was actually the biggest cancer of the sect for thirty years! Ling Yuan's brow furrowed slightly, his fingers that had been tapping in his sleeve stopped, and a solemn glint flashed in his eyes.

"Eye of Breaking the Game, open!" Chen Ji gave a low cry, and the vertical pupil at his brow center suddenly opened, golden light illuminating the entire plaza. Under that light, blood-red chains actually appeared on the Second Elder's body, those chains piercing through his soul and connecting to some indescribable existence in the depths of the Void. "See it now?" Chen Ji's voice was cold as frost. "This is the 'grace' your master granted you—a leash that can take your life at any moment!"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan finally moved. He stepped forward, his powerful aura surging forth like a tide, attempting to interrupt Chen Ji's incantation. "Enough, Chen Ji." His voice was calm yet carried an unquestionable authority. "Whatever the Second Elder did, the sect rules will handle it. You're just a Servant Disciple, acting beyond your authority—have you put the sect in your eyes at all?" On the surface he seemed to be upholding justice, but in truth he was buying time for the Second Elder.

choice.prompt: Faced with Ling Yuan's intervention, Chen Ji chose:

choices.description: Directly expose Ling Yuan's relationship with the Second Elder, revealing him as the mastermind before everyone
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's image of a cunning old strategist collapsed in the hearts of the disciples
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength is unfathomable, openly turning against him carries great risk

dialogue.content: "Sect Master Ling," Chen Ji turned to Ling Yuan, a meaningful smile curling at his lips, "Are you sure you want to speak for him at this moment? The list I have isn't just about the Second Elder... Would you like to hear, who 'borrowed' the Tianji Record Fragment from the scripture vault thirty years ago?" At these words, Ling Yuan's expression finally changed.

result_nodes.description: Deal with the Second Elder first, settle accounts with Ling Yuan later—don't alert the snake
result_nodes.visible_cost: Let Ling Yuan off this once
result_nodes.visible_reward: Keep the trump card hidden, deal Ling Yuan a more lethal blow in the future

dialogue.content: "Sect Master Ling's lecturing is well taken." Chen Ji gave a slight nod, his posture respectful, but those two eyes were like twin daggers. "Since the Sect Master says we should follow the rules, then I shall follow the rules—the Second Elder colluded with the Demonic Path, betrayed the sect, harmed fellow disciples, and according to sect law, should face extreme punishment. I believe the Sect Master will render a fair judgment." He withdrew his gaze, but mentally noted: "Ling Yuan, the account between us—another day."

result_nodes.description: Warn both Ling Yuan and the Second Elder at the same time—whoever moves gets dealt with together
result_nodes.visible_cost: Make two powerful enemies at once
result_nodes.visible_reward: Establish absolute prestige, build an image in the sect that no one dares provoke
result_nodes.risk_hint: Too many enemies, may invite bigger troubles

dialogue.content: Chen Ji surveyed the two men, then suddenly laughed. That smile carried a playful quality. "Sect Master Ling, Second Elder, why don't you two discuss it—who wants to die first?" His tone was carefree, as if discussing today's weather. "Or, you can come together." At these words, silence fell over the entire crowd. No one could believe their ears—this waste of a disciple actually had the audacity to provoke both the Sect Master and an Elder at the same time!

result_nodes.description: Using the Heavenly Eye chains displayed by the Breaking Bureau Eye to designate the Second Elder as a traitor and execute him according to sect rules
result_nodes.visible_cost: Need some time to set up the scheme
result_nodes.visible_reward: Properly execute the Second Elder according to justice while displaying the threat of the Heavenly Eye to the entire sect
result_nodes.risk_hint: May be detected by the Heavenly Eye in advance

dialogue.content: Chen Ji ignored Ling Yuan and turned to all the disciples present, shouting loudly: "Fellow disciples, you all saw it! The chains on the Second Elder's body are the mark of the Heavenly Eye! He is a traitor to Heaven and a criminal against humanity!" His voice echoed across the plaza, each word striking like a heavy hammer against everyone's hearts.

text.content: Golden formation patterns revolved continuously around Chen Ji as the Tianji Record's fourth level 'Heavenly Fate Deduction' and the Breaking Bureau Eye's combined technique 'Expose the Illusion, Reveal the Truth' operated simultaneously, exposing all the Second Elder's secrets before the public eye. Those blood-red chains writhed grotesquely in the void, emitting ear-piercing shrieks, as if something was peering through them.

dialogue.content: "Second Elder, the thing you worship at the Rear Mountain Forbidden Grounds every midnight of the lunar calendar," Chen Ji's voice was like from the Nine幽 Hells, "is the Heavenly Eye, isn't it? How many disciples' lives have you exchanged with it? Ten? A hundred? Or more?" He advanced step by step. The Second Elder had no room to retreat, his back against a stone pillar, trembling violently like a sieve.

text.content: "I... I confess! I'll confess everything!" The Second Elder finally broke down, kneeling on the ground with tears and mucus flowing. "It's the Heavenly Eye! It gave me power, gave me a method to extend my lifespan! It told me to collect the essence blood of Heavenly Fate individuals—each sacrifice grants me ten years of life! Those disciples... those disciples were all chosen by it! I was just... just an executor!" His voice grew smaller and smaller, finally turning into whimpers.

choice.prompt: The Second Elder confessed publicly, and Chen Ji faced the final decision on his punishment:

choices.description: Use the Heavenly Eye's own methods to execute him, deterring all potential traitors
choices.visible_cost: May沾染 the Heavenly Eye's aura
choices.visible_reward: Establish authority within the sect, letting everyone know the consequences of betrayal
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the Heavenly Eye's intervention

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak again. He raised his hand, and the golden formation patterns of the Tianji Record turned into a stream of light, directly entering the Second Elder's brow center. A tragic scream resounded across the entire plaza as the Second Elder's body convulsed violently. The blood-red chains connected to the void suddenly tensed, then collapsed with a thunderous crash! His soul was wrapped in golden light, crushed bit by bit, finally dissolving into specks of dust that scattered in the wind. "Traitors," Chen Ji's voice was calm as water, "meet this end."

choices.description: Hold the Second Elder in custody for future interrogation and obtain more intelligence about the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_cost: May give him a chance to escape
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Heavenly Eye's布局 from the Second Elder
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may come to rescue him

text.content: "Guards!" Chen Ji shouted. Several law enforcement disciples quickly stepped forward. "Take this traitor to the Heavenly Prison and keep him under strict watch!" As the Second Elder was dragged away, he kept begging for mercy, but Chen Ji didn't even glance at him. He turned around, his gaze falling on Ling Yuan, a slight smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Sect Master Ling, you just said we should follow the rules—now the rules are here. Do you think the punishment is appropriate?" This question set Ling Yuan on the grill.

choices.description: Only destroy his cultivation and memories, turning him into atrash before releasing him—showing strength without creating bloodshed
choices.visible_cost: Waste a living source of intelligence
choices.visible_reward: To show mercy before the crowd while completely destroying everything the Second Elder has
choices.risk_hint: Risk of future retaliation by the Second Elder

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, and a golden light pierced into the Second Elder's Brow Center. The Second Elder let out a miserable shriek, blood flowing from his seven orifices as the spiritual energy throughout his body gushed out like a breached flood. 'Your cultivation, your memories, your connection to the Heavenly Eye,' Chen Ji looked down at him, 'I will erase them all for you. From now on, you'll be an ordinary mortal—who can't even remember who he is.' The Second Elder's gaze gradually turned hollow, eventually losing all focus entirely.

text.content: A deathly silence descended upon the plaza. Everyone stood frozen, unable to believe what they had witnessed—the servant disciple, once deemed worthless, possessed such terrifying power that he could crush an elder, expose the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy, and determine life and death before the Sect Master's eyes. Ling Yuan's expression turned chillingly grim, yet he forced a thin smile: 'Chen Ji, you truly embody righteousness, purging this great evil for the sect... truly, a remarkable young talent.'

Chen Ji turned to face Ling Yuan, his deep eyes seemingly capable of seeing through all illusions. 'Sect Master Ling,' his voice was calm, 'you should feel fortunate.' Ling Yuan frowned: 'What do you mean?' Chen Ji smiled faintly, a smile carrying inexplicable undertones: 'Fortunate that I'm in a good mood today, and only killed one traitor. If someday I'm in a bad mood...' He didn't finish, but the cold gleam in those eyes had already sunk Ling Yuan's heart to the depths.

Just then, a sudden change occurred! The clear sky instantly darkened, and an overwhelming pressure poured down from the nine heavens. Chen Ji frowned, looking up to see a massive crimson fissure torn across the heavens, with a colossal eye made of countless stars slowly emerging from the rift. Within that eye there was no pupil, only chaotic void, yet merely gazing upon it felt one's very soul would shatter. 'Insignificant creature...' An ancient yet majestic voice came from the Void, 'You dare challenge me?'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He never expected that his execution of the Second Elder and shattering of the Heavenly Fate chains would directly alert this ultimate antagonist. The Tianji Record within him vibrated frantically, as if warning of something. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in the first page also fluctuated violently, letting out an urgent whisper: 'Not good! It's descended prematurely! Chen Xuan's chess game... the heavens are about to change!'

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the shock in his heart. He knew that from this moment, his official confrontation with the Heavenly Eye had begun. The Second Elder was merely a minor character; the true mastermind was now gazing down at this insignificant creature who dared challenge Heavenly authority with the posture of heavenly might. 'Heavenly Eye...' Chen Ji murmured to himself, his lips suddenly curving into a meaningful arc, 'I've been waiting... for you for a very long time.'

The blood-colored fissure slowly expanded in the sky, that star-composed eye becoming increasingly clear. Each star was a pupil, countless pupils gazing at you simultaneously, as if to thoroughly see through your very soul. The Heavenly Eye's pressure was like a materialized mountain, pressing down so that everyone present dared not raise their heads. Only Chen Ji stood alone, hands clasped behind his back, facing the heavens. In his eyes, the Breaking Formation Eye and the Tianji Record's golden light frantically intertwined, and an unyielding battle intent rose from him toward the sky. 'Come then,' his voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire Tianqing Sect, 'Let me see just how strong this so-called Heaven actually is!'
